descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云国际身份证识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，适用于出入境审查、国内外身份核验等各种需要提取身份证信息的场景。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |多国身份证|对越南、韩国、印度、孟加拉居民身份证提供识别服务| |图像增强|默认支持图像增强，包括图像自动旋转、畸变自动矫正、模糊图片自动增强等能力。| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |高精度识别|总体识别准确率可达98%。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [个人证照识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_personalcard_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=standard&subtype=idcard#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[国际身份证识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_personalcard_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_personalcard_dp_cn_20220829103503_0482%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。您也可以不购买资源包，系统会通过“[按量付费](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html)”方式按实际调用量自动扣款。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeInternationalIdcard?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP、OFD、PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
| |其他提示|
  • 请保证整张身份证内容及其边缘包含在图像内。
  • 本能力会自动处理反光、扭曲等干扰信息，但会影响精度。请尽量选择清晰度高、无反光、无扭曲的图片。
|
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud International ID Card Recognition is an official self-developed OCR product from Alibaba Cloud, suitable for scenarios such as immigration inspection and identity verification within or outside China, where information extraction from ID cards is required. * Based on DAMO Academy’s advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud’s OCR product has been refined over years of development and offers key advantages including service stability, ease of operation, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Categorization | Overview | |---|---------| | Multi-country ID Cards | Provides recognition services for resident ID cards from Vietnam, South Korea, India, Bangladesh, and other countries. | | Image Enhancement | Supports image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Coverage of Multiple Types | Supports recognition of low-quality images, including those that are blurry, unevenly lit, perspective-distorted, or have arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-Accuracy Recognition | Achieves an overall recognition accuracy rate of up to 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Personal Document Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_personalcard_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can freely test the recognition performance of this feature through the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=standard&subtype=idcard#intro). | | 2 | Purchase an [International ID Card Recognition Resource Plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_personalcard_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_personalcard_dp_cn_20220829103503_0482%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota for testing purposes. Alternatively, you may choose not to purchase a resource plan; the system will automatically charge based on actual usage under the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing model. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeInternationalIdcard?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration. After integration, invoke the API to retrieve the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For detailed authorization steps, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the User Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports the following formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, WebP, OFD, and PDF.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Both image height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (width-to-height or height-to-width) must be less than 50.
  • For optimal recognition results, it is recommended that both dimensions exceed 500 pixels.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Excessively large images may affect API response speed. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Other Tips |
  • Ensure that the entire ID card content, including its edges, is fully visible within the image.
  • This capability automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, though these factors may impact accuracy. Please use images with high definition, no glare, and no distortion whenever possible.
|
